diagram_previews.alt: Case 1: acute triangle ABC with its grey circumcircle, the dotted altitudes with feet D, E, F, and the blue line EF extended beyond E to meet the circumcircle at P on the same side of AB as C; the blue segment DF meets BP at Q between F and D; the red segments AP and AQ, and the dashed green circle through A, F, P and Q.

Case 2: the same triangle with P the other intersection of line EF with the circumcircle, beyond F on the far side of AB from C; line DF extended beyond F meets line BP beyond P at Q, above and to the left of A; the red segments AP and AQ, and the dashed green circle through A, F, P and Q.

difficulty_rationale: IMO Shortlist G1: one must find the auxiliary circle through A, F, P, Q and handle both intersection points of EF with the circumcircle; several connected insights.
